subject.title: fix(agents): idle-timeout stalled provider response body reads

question: Should all shared provider response readers enforce a universal 30-second body-idle ceiling, or must the idle timeout remain owned by each caller's provider/request deadline?
rationale: Both policies are technically viable, but they have different compatibility guarantees for slow providers and public plugin consumers, so repository intent is required before merge.

options.title: Keep timeout caller-owned
options.body: Derive or pass chunkTimeoutMs from the existing operation deadline so stalled bodies terminate without shortening valid provider timeouts.

options.title: Adopt the universal cutoff
options.body: Intentionally standardize on 30 seconds, document the new plugin/provider behavior, and add upgrade proof for slow-response callers.

recommendation.title: Keep timeout caller-owned
recommendation.body: Derive or pass chunkTimeoutMs from the existing operation deadline so stalled bodies terminate without shortening valid provider timeouts.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed and merged the original endpoint-scoped chunk-timeout implementation and are the strongest available owner for its intended policy boundary.
